title: Simple Economy Expansion
description: This mod adds a variety of economy related items, such as cash and a wallet. This mod is a WIP and more will be added later.
body:
This mod is an extension of Minecraft's current economy. So far, it adds cash, and a wallet, which is used to give cash. In the future, I am thinking of addding things like stocks, banks, and a villager profession that can be interacted with for money.



Please use the comments only for suggestions and not asking for the mod to be ported to diffrent loaders or versions.
